text:
# Pre-market brief, Fri 2026-10-30 (~8:30 AM ET)

1. **AI-capex selloff deepens.** NQ futures −2.4 to −2.5%, ES −1%, Dow futures flat to +0.2% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-083236552.html); [Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-tumble-as-amazon-intel-results-deepen-ai-spending-woes-4986163)). NQ below 29k, 200-SMA ~28.5k next ([Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/daily/5835-us-market-open-amazon-and-intel-disappoint-further-weighing-on-nq-futures-qatari-delegation-arrives-in-tehran)).
2. **INTC −23 to −26% pre**: Q4 guide adj EPS $0.25 vs $0.43–0.44 est., rev $15–16B vs $17.1B; warns of cash burn ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-intc-amzn-rddt-cvx.html); [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/daily/5835-us-market-open-amazon-and-intel-disappoint-further-weighing-on-nq-futures-qatari-delegation-arrives-in-tehran)). Semis hit: AMD −8.7%, NVDA −3% pre ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-tumble-as-amazon-intel-results-deepen-ai-spending-woes-4986163)).
3. **AMZN −6 to −7% pre**: Q3 miss, FCF −$42.4B, Q4 op-income guide $28.5–33.5B vs $33.2B ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-intc-amzn-rddt-cvx.html); [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/daily/5835-us-market-open-amazon-and-intel-disappoint-further-weighing-on-nq-futures-qatari-delegation-arrives-in-tehran)). RDDT −21% (weak Q4 guide), RBLX −17 to −18% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-intc-amzn-rddt-cvx.html); [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-october-30-2026)).
4. **Crypto**: $6.3B Binance hack (record), ~$3B frozen; BTC −3 to −4% to ~$77.4k, $1.5B liquidations; COIN/HOOD −4%+ ([CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/10/30/usd6-billion-binance-hack-sends-bitcoin-ether-tumbling-standard-chartered-sees-more-losses-ahead); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/bitcoin-ether-price-binance-security-scare-rattles-crypto-markets.html)).
5. **Gainers**: XOM +1.4% (profit $15.4B vs $7.5B), CVX +1.4% (net income $9.9B, rev beat), AZN +5% (core EPS $2.79 vs $2.60), RIVN +8% (delivery guide up), SNY +3.9% (FY guide raised) ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-intc-amzn-rddt-cvx.html); [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/stock-market-today-live-october-30-2026)).
6. **Rates/oil**: 10y −5bp to 4.933%, 2y 4.589% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/30/us-treasury-yields-fed-interest-rates.html)); Brent $113, WTI $104 ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-friday-october-30-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-083236552.html)). Dec hike odds ~75% ([TradingEconomics](https://tradingeconomics.com/united-states/government-bond-yield/news/596546)).
7. **Calendar**: ECI 8:30 today, est. 0.8% q/q ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/10_sched.htm); [MetalsMine](https://www.metalsmine.com/calendar/179-us-employment-cost-index-qq)). Next week: AAPL, PLTR 11/2 AMC; AMD 11/3 AMC; UBER 11/4 BMO; MCD 11/4 (expected); jobs report 11/6 8:30 ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/earnings-calendar-week-of-november-2-2026)). SHOP, PFE 11/3 BMO ([TiltRadar](https://tiltradar.com/earnings)). Midterms 11/3.

## Swing ideas
- **CVX** long, low. Q3 net income ~3x to $9.9B, rev beat, +1.4% pre with Brent $113. Risk: oil premium fades on Iran talks (Qatari delegation in Tehran).
- **SNY** long, low. Q3 sales +14.3% cc, FY guide raised, +3.9% pre; healthcare leading. Risk: gap fades in risk-off tape.
